title: Foundational Concept 1
summary: Biomolecules have unique properties that shape cell structure and function and support the processes required for life.

title: Foundational Concept 2
summary: Organized assemblies of molecules, cells, and organs interact to perform the functions of living organisms.

title: Foundational Concept 3
summary: Integrated tissue and organ systems sense internal and external environments and maintain stable internal conditions.

title: Foundational Concept 4
summary: Living organisms transport material, sense signals, and respond to change through processes explained by physical principles.

title: Foundational Concept 5
summary: Chemical interactions and reactions provide the basis for understanding molecular dynamics in living systems.

title: Foundational Concept 6
summary: Biological, psychological, and sociocultural factors influence how people perceive, think about, and react to the world.

title: Foundational Concept 7
summary: Biological, psychological, and sociocultural factors influence behavior and behavior change.

title: Foundational Concept 8
summary: Psychological, sociocultural, and biological factors influence self-concept, views of others, and social interaction.

title: Foundational Concept 9
summary: Cultural and social differences influence well-being.

title: Foundational Concept 10
summary: Social stratification and access to resources influence well-being.
